claim: McCoy v. Alamu, 141 S. Ct. 1364 (2021), summarily vacated a Fifth Circuit decision granting immunity to a correctional officer who deployed pepper spray into an inmate's face.
excerpt:
Cotton , 572 U.S. 650 (2014) (per cu- riam), this Court summarily reversed a Fifth Circuit decision granting qualified immunity at the sum- mary-judgment stage to officers who shot an unarmed victim on his front porch. As this Court explained, the Fifth Circuit’s decision granting qualified immunity “failed to view the evidence at summary judgment in the light most favorable to [the plaintiff] with respect to the central facts of this case.” Id.
